topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: The commission compensates the investment professional and his or her firm when it is acting as an agent for you in your securities transaction.
answer: A commission is one way an investment professional may be compensated: it can be charged when you buy or sell an investment through them. To understand how compensation works, ask how commissions are determined and whether the professional is paid differently for different products. These questions can help you understand what you may be charged and how the professional gets paid.
